careers.title: Join the team
careers.intro: We are looking for reliable drivers to transfer premium vehicles across Germany and Europe. You work independently, treat every vehicle as your own, and punctuality is second nature to you.
tasks: Transferring vehicles on their own wheels
Pickup and delivery at customers and dealerships
requirements: Valid category B driving licence (min. 2 years)
process: You fill in the online form and upload your CV
We review your application within 5 business days
Phone call and a personal introduction
